sections.text: Introduction

This document out lines the major maintenance 
procedures P2, which must be performed from six to eight years as indicated by 
Y6:8 in the title block for the minimum "low" oil circuit breaker:
- Rated Voltage: 66KV - Rated current: 2500 A - Short circuit current: 3l. 5 KA /1sec

The first draft initiated by eng. Samer Ayad at Sabtia 
I Cairo

Safety
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,

Safety fence 
(rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required

CB must be
isolated completely and grounded on both sides,

Wear safety
helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glasses

Control Power
disconnected.

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Drain
approximately 2 litter sump-oil through oil tap (18) in continental climate.

Drain
approximately 2 litter sump-oil through oil tap (18) in humid and hot humid
atmosphere conditions.

Drain oil
sample from breaker pole and test according to specification:
- The gap 2.5
mm. 
- 30 kV-rms.
Clean oil
- 25 kV-rms. Oil
in CB
- 15 kV-rms.
Used oil.
- 10 kV limits for satisfactory operation of the CB

Top up with
fresh clean oil.

Smear gasket
to ventilating lid (38) with silicon grease.
Replace ventilating lid.
